name: value
meaning: The selected value or displayed measurement; domain and type are component-specific.
whenToUse: Expose the primary selection or magnitude.
avoid: Do not infer editability, numeric universality or shared normalization.

name: defaultValue
meaning: The initial value of an uncontrolled interactive component.
whenToUse: An actual interactive API supports uncontrolled initialization.
avoid: Passive measurements such as Gauge or APIs without uncontrolled behavior.

name: onValueChange
meaning: Notification of a user-driven value change in an interactive component.
whenToUse: The component actually emits selection or editing changes.
avoid: Passive displays such as Gauge or notifications for incoming prop updates.

name: size
meaning: Component-specific dimensions through supported presets or custom dimensions.
whenToUse: Choose dimensional presets or custom dimensions supported by the component.
avoid: Assuming identical dimensions or accepted types across components; Gauge numeric CSS-pixel support does not extend Tabs or IconButton. Gauge finite-positive validation, invalid-size behavior and any min/max policy still require review.

usages.type: GaugeSize | number (GaugeSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'; numeric CSS pixels, e.g. 64)

name: variant
meaning: Visual treatment within a component's responsibility.
whenToUse: Choose presentation such as an outline or segmented treatment.
avoid: Consumer-selected condition or Surface material tone.

name: tone
meaning: A component's color tone: a semantic status family or a material surface tone; values are component-specific.
whenToUse: Select the tone family a component supports, such as Badge or Mark status tones.
avoid: A consumer-selected measurement condition (use state), arbitrary colors, or assuming every component exposes the same tone values.

name: elevation
meaning: The elevation treatment of a material surface.
whenToUse: A surface exposes a supported elevation axis.
avoid: Condition, dimensions or an arbitrary shadow value.

usages.type: SurfaceElevation (0|1|2|3); never on well and overlay

name: label
meaning: The accessible name of the control or displayed magnitude.
whenToUse: The public API owns an explicit accessible-name input.
avoid: Assuming Surface has this prop or using it as a generic visible caption.

usages.type: string (required only in the icon-only branch)

name: state
meaning: The consumer-selected interpretation of a Gauge magnitude or an independent GaugeGroup ring magnitude, independent of thresholds.
whenToUse: A Gauge or GaugeGroup ring exposes consumer-selected normal, warning, critical or muted measurement conditions.
avoid: Visual variants, material tone, loading behavior or automatic threshold inference.

name: stateText
meaning: Visible non-color text describing the selected condition of a Gauge magnitude or independent GaugeGroup ring.
whenToUse: Supply condition text, required for non-normal Gauge or GaugeGroup ring states by their conditional unions.
avoid: Replacing the accessible name or the numeric equivalent.

name: valueText
meaning: A contextual text equivalent of a normalized displayed magnitude or determinate task-progress value.
whenToUse: A magnitude or task-progress display exposes a readable value equivalent coherent with its component-specific normalization.
avoid: Condition text, accessible naming, incoherent raw out-of-range values, unavailable-data messages or indeterminate-progress feedback.

name: center
meaning: Optional decorative, non-interactive content inside a Gauge ring or GaugeGroup's shared innermost hole.
whenToUse: Propose an icon, value or short text with meaning already represented accessibly.
avoid: Actions, focusable descendants, a fixed logo or the sole source of meaning.

name: unavailableText
meaning: Readable fallback when a numeric or remaining-time display is unavailable and exposes no value.
whenToUse: Propose non-empty unavailable-data text separately from invalid-input policy approval.
avoid: Loading or initial clock sampling, disabled state, fabricated zero values, genuine expired zero time, indeterminate task progress or assuming fallback wording is approved.

name: profile
meaning: A named preset of engine parameters for a decorative effect layer.
whenToUse: Select among the effect presets supported by the component, such as density and speed profiles.
avoid: Do not use it for visual Material treatment, sizes or arbitrary per-parameter overrides; preset names and values are component-specific.

name: opacity
meaning: The opacity of a decorative effect layer, a number from 0 to 1.
whenToUse: Let the consumer fade a decorative layer in or out; a component may stop its work at 0.
avoid: Do not use it as a general appearance override for interactive components or text; clamping and non-finite handling are component-specific.

name: badgeIcon
meaning: System glyph shown in a small decorative badge overlaid on a corner of the component, such as the network of a channel avatar.
whenToUse: Mark the origin or network of the represented entity with a corner glyph.
avoid: Leading glyphs next to content (use leading-icon/icon), counts or status (use Badge or StatusDot), or the sole source of meaning.

name: paused
meaning: Shows the represented entity as paused or inactive with visual de-emphasis and data-state="paused".
whenToUse: A channel, account or similar entity is paused and the meaning is also given in text.
avoid: Disabled controls (use native disabled), loading, or as the only cue for the paused meaning.

name: icon
meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology. Button alone may place this icon before or after its label, after it by default. Toggle alone also accepts a required decorative icon as its sole visible content, with a required accessible label. IconButton alone requires one decorative ReactElement icon, named separately by its required label.
whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text. Button alone also permits its iconPosition start/end slot, default end. Toggle alone permits its icon-only branch when icon and accessible label are both required. IconButton alone also permits required decorative icon-only content with a separate required label.
avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning. Three scoped exceptions apply: Button with iconPosition may place the icon after its label; Toggle with a required icon and accessible label may render icon-only; IconButton.icon with its required label is icon-only by design. No other component gains trailing-icon or icon-only permission, and interactive icons remain excluded.

usages.type: ReactNode (decorative start/end slot, default end; Button-only semantic exception)
ReactElement (optional leading icon with text; required icon-only with required label)
ReactElement (required decorative icon, separately named by required label)

name: iconPosition
meaning: Which side of the visible label a component's decorative icon slot is rendered on.
whenToUse: A labelled control or link exposes an optional decorative icon that may lead or trail its label.
avoid: Icon-only controls, icon identity or size, or reordering meaningful content.

name: loading
meaning: The control has started an operation that is still pending; it stays focusable but cannot be activated again.
whenToUse: An action control shows in-progress feedback for an operation it triggered.
avoid: Disabled semantics, data-fetching placeholders, skeletons or progress with a known value.

name: asChild
meaning: Render the component's behavior and styling onto its single child element through Radix Slot instead of its default element.
whenToUse: A consumer must supply the element, such as an anchor or a router link, while keeping the component's contract.
avoid: Multiple children, wrapping non-element content, or changing the component's semantic role.

usages.type: boolean (discriminates native required href from child-owned href)

name: onCheckedChange
meaning: Notification of a user-driven change of a binary or mixed checked state, receiving the next checked state.
whenToUse: A checkbox or switch control emits its next checked state when the user toggles it.
avoid: Selection of a value among options (use onValueChange), pressed buttons (use onPressedChange), or notifications for incoming prop updates.

name: pressed
meaning: Controlled on/off pressed state of a toggle control, exposed as aria-pressed.
whenToUse: A single control persists an on/off state the user switches by pressing it.
avoid: Selection of a value from a set (use value), form checkbox semantics (checked) or transient active styling.

name: defaultPressed
meaning: Initial pressed state of an uncontrolled toggle control.
whenToUse: A toggle control supports uncontrolled use alongside the pressed prop.
avoid: Controlled components without uncontrolled behavior or value-based selection.

name: onPressedChange
meaning: Notification of a user-driven change of a toggle control's pressed state, with the next boolean.
whenToUse: A toggle control emits pressed changes from user interaction.
avoid: Value selection changes (use onValueChange) or notifications for incoming prop updates.

name: onFiles
meaning: Notification carrying the files the user picked, dropped or pasted into a file target.
whenToUse: A component accepts files from the user and hands them to the consumer for validation and upload.
avoid: Upload progress or results, value changes of non-file inputs, or validation feedback.

name: dropLabel
meaning: Visible text a drop target shows while compatible items are dragged over it.
whenToUse: A drop target replaces its resting text during drag-over, such as Drop here.
avoid: The resting accessible name, error messages or generic hover text.

name: name
meaning: Identifier of the glyph that the Icon component draws from the closed system icon set.
whenToUse: Select which system glyph Icon renders.
avoid: Icon slots inside other components (use leading-icon/icon), native form-control name attributes or arbitrary SVG content.

name: filled
meaning: Renders a stroke glyph with a solid currentColor fill in addition to its stroke.
whenToUse: A glyph needs its solid form, such as a play triangle.
avoid: Selected, pressed or active state, or any color change.

name: external
meaning: The link opens its destination in a new browsing context with safe rel values and an external cue.
whenToUse: A navigational component links to a destination that should open in a new tab, usually outside the product.
avoid: Marking same-tab links as external, download behavior, or styling-only treatments.

name: newTabText
meaning: Readable text announcing that a link opens in a new tab, rendered for assistive technology.
whenToUse: A component that can open a new tab lets consumers localize the notice.
avoid: Replacing the link's accessible name or describing the destination.

name: arrow
meaning: Whether a link shows its trailing decorative direction arrow; the glyph is derived by the component.
whenToUse: A text link may hide its built-in arrow, for example in legal or dense footer links.
avoid: Choosing arbitrary icons or conveying meaning through the arrow alone.

name: rule
meaning: Short code or letter of the review rule that flagged a piece of content, shown next to it.
whenToUse: A highlighted fragment must show which linter or style rule produced it, linking it to its notice.
avoid: Status tone, accessible naming, validation rules of form fields or long rule descriptions.

name: monogram
meaning: The one or two visible characters that identify a product in a compact brand mark.
whenToUse: A compact product mark shows letters instead of artwork.
avoid: Accessible naming (use accessible-name/label), user initials in avatars, or long text.

name: edge
meaning: Pins a thin decorative-or-status strip to the bottom edge of its positioned container, spanning its full width.
whenToUse: A progress or status strip must sit flush on a container edge, such as the SectionNav button.
avoid: Generic positioning, side selection for floating content or layout overrides; the container must be positioned and clip overflow.

name: options
meaning: Ordered list of selectable options, each with a value, a visible text label and optional per-option disabled state; item shape is component-specific.
whenToUse: A selection component renders a standard item for each option from data.
avoid: Custom item rendering (compose primitives instead), navigation items or arbitrary ReactNode collections.

usages.type: SelectOption[] (value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean)

name: orientation
meaning: Main axis of a component's items or of a semantic separator; an interactive collection's arrow-key navigation follows that axis.
whenToUse: A collection's layout and keyboard model share an axis, or a passive separator exposes its horizontal or vertical semantic orientation.
avoid: Purely visual direction changes in generic layout primitives, text direction (use dir), or inventing keyboard behavior for passive separators.

name: placeholder
meaning: Hint text shown in a choice control while no value is selected; not the accessible name or a default value.
whenToUse: A non-native choice control (such as a Radix Select trigger) needs the equivalent of a native input placeholder.
avoid: Native inputs and textareas, which already have the placeholder attribute; using it as a label, instruction that must stay visible, or selected value.

usages.type: string (hint only while unselected; not an accessible name)

name: onValueCommit
meaning: Notification of the final value when the user ends a continuous interaction such as a drag or a keyboard step.
whenToUse: A continuous control lets consumers defer expensive work until the user settles on a value, alongside onValueChange.
avoid: Discrete selections where every change is final, form submission or notifications for incoming prop updates.

name: delta
meaning: Short secondary text that gives context to a displayed figure, such as its latest change or why it is unavailable.
whenToUse: A figure component shows a one-line change summary or a no-data reason under its value.
avoid: Accessible naming, long descriptions, help text for form fields or the figure itself.

name: highlighted
meaning: Consumer-controlled, temporary emphasis that draws attention to a component after its content changed.
whenToUse: The consumer briefly emphasizes one item (for example a live total that just changed) and removes the emphasis itself.
avoid: Selection, pressed or current state, persistent status tones, or component-managed timers.

name: pulse
meaning: Whether a decorative signal indicator or placeholder plays its pulse animation; reduced-motion preferences always stop it.
whenToUse: A decorative signal indicator or content placeholder offers an optional pulsing emphasis that the consumer can switch to a static presentation.
avoid: Progress or completion animation, general motion toggles for interactive components, or conveying meaning only through motion.

name: content
meaning: Supplementary plain text shown by a floating hint attached to a trigger.
whenToUse: A tooltip-like component shows a short, non-essential, non-interactive description on hover or focus.
avoid: Accessible names, essential instructions, interactive or rich content, or page content slots.

name: side
meaning: The preferred side of the trigger where floating content is placed before collision handling.
whenToUse: A floating component (tooltip, popover, menu) lets the consumer choose top, right, bottom or left.
avoid: Edge pinning inside a container, text direction or alignment along the side.

name: ratio
meaning: The width-to-height proportion of a reserved media or content region, independent of its rendered dimensions.
whenToUse: A primitive or media component reserves proportional space; the component-specific type may be a numeric width divided by height or a documented set of format presets.
avoid: Absolute width or height, image crop or object-fit policy, measurement values, or Material treatment.

name: items
meaning: Ordered data describing the entries a composite component renders, such as tabs, menu entries or navigation links; the entry shape is component-specific.
whenToUse: A molecule renders its own standard entry, with its sub-parts, for each element of a consumer-supplied list.
avoid: Selectable form options (use choice-options/options), free composition through children, or ReactNode lists without a defined entry shape.

name: messages
meaning: Component-specific dictionary of localizable built-in interface text and text formatters, with documented defaults for omitted entries.
whenToUse: A composite component owns several related control labels, instructions or announcements that consumers need to translate together.
avoid: User-authored content, the component's primary accessible name (use label), styling, behavior configuration or a global translation provider.

name: type
meaning: Whether a value-selection group allows at most one selected option or multiple selected options.
whenToUse: A group explicitly supports single and multiple selection, with string and string-array value APIs respectively.
avoid: Native button or input type attributes, visual treatments (use variant), boolean pressed state or requiring a form selection.

name: deadline
meaning: Absolute instant at which a countdown reaches zero, expressed as Unix epoch milliseconds.
whenToUse: A time-based display counts down to one consumer-supplied instant with component-specific validity bounds.
avoid: Durations, local calendar strings without timezone resolution, animation timing, task progress or automatic server-clock synchronization.

name: deadlineText
meaning: Human-readable date, time and timezone describing the absolute deadline independently of the changing remaining duration.
whenToUse: A countdown supplies persistent readable context for its target instant and consumers own localization and timezone wording.
avoid: The current numeric remainder, timer accessible name, expired messages, unverified event-start claims or automatic locale parsing.

name: units
meaning: Ordered localized labels for the day, hour, minute and second columns of a remaining-time display.
whenToUse: A countdown renders a fixed four-unit breakdown and consumers provide short unit names or abbreviations.
avoid: Measurement units of unrelated figures, duration values, arbitrary item collections or assuming grammatical pluralization is automatic.

name: onExpire
meaning: Notification that the client observed a countdown deadline reached, receiving the expired instant in Unix epoch milliseconds.
whenToUse: A countdown reports expiration with an explicit component-specific episode and remount policy so consumers can react or announce separately.
avoid: Per-second ticks, user-driven value changes, callbacks during render or SSR, authoritative event-start signals or cross-instance exactly-once guarantees.

name: initializingText
meaning: Readable placeholder while a time-based display has not yet sampled its client clock.
whenToUse: A countdown deliberately renders deterministic server and initial hydration content before starting its client clock.
avoid: Invalid or missing measurements (use unavailableText), loading controls, fabricated zero time or automatically announced status.

name: expiredText
meaning: Visible text explaining that a countdown's target instant has been reached.
whenToUse: A countdown retains a genuine zero readout and adds a localizable non-live expiration explanation.
avoid: Assuming an event is live or completed, invalid-input messages, automatic announcements or the remaining duration itself.

name: decorative
meaning: Whether a passive separator is visual decoration rather than a meaningful content boundary exposed to assistive technology.
whenToUse: A separator supports both decorative use beside text and semantic use between content regions without changing its paint.
avoid: Hiding meaningful content, naming controls, interactive window splitters, visibility toggles or changing focus behavior.

name: hint
meaning: Muted help text shown with a form control and linked to it as its description.
whenToUse: A labelled form control needs persistent guidance such as format, consequences or limits.
avoid: Error messages (use error), accessible names, placeholders or long documentation.

name: error
meaning: Consumer-supplied validation message that marks the form control invalid and is linked to it as its description.
whenToUse: A form control's current value fails validation and the consumer explains why in text.
avoid: Validation logic, status tones of non-form components, toasts or page-level alerts.

name: counter
meaning: Current length and maximum length of a text control, shown as a visible counter that changes tone when exceeded.
whenToUse: A text field has a length limit the user should see while typing.
avoid: Item counts, badges, numeric values of non-text controls, or replacing the error message.

name: readout
meaning: Visible text of a control's current value shown next to its label in an output element linked to the control.
whenToUse: A control whose value is not readable on the control itself, such as a slider, shows its formatted value.
avoid: Accessible value text (use the control's own value text), counters, hints or editable values.

name: hideLabel
meaning: Hides a required visible label visually while keeping it in the accessibility tree as the control's name.
whenToUse: The surrounding layout already makes the purpose obvious, such as a search box in a toolbar.
avoid: Omitting the label, icon-only buttons (use their label prop) or hiding hints and errors.

name: layout
meaning: Arrangement of a control and its label: label stacked above the control, or the control beside its label in one row.
whenToUse: A wrapper places text fields with a stacked label and checkboxes or switches with an inline label.
avoid: Item axes with keyboard navigation (use orientation), visual treatments (use variant) or page layout.

name: align
meaning: Alignment of floating content along the chosen side of its trigger (start, center or end) before collision handling.
whenToUse: A floating component such as a menu or popover lets the consumer line its panel up with the trigger's start, center or end edge.
avoid: Text alignment, layout alignment of in-flow content, or choosing the side (use floating-side/side).

name: open
meaning: Controlled visibility of a component's disclosed, floating or transient content, such as a collapsible group, panel or notification.
whenToUse: A component lets the consumer control whether its disclosed, floating or transient content is shown, together with onOpenChange.
avoid: Selection, pressed or checked state (use value, pressed or checked), or content that is always visible.

name: defaultOpen
meaning: Initial visibility of an uncontrolled disclosure, floating or transient component.
whenToUse: A component supports uncontrolled initialization alongside the open prop; its initial default is component-specific.
avoid: Controlled-only components or initial selection values (use defaultValue).

name: onOpenChange
meaning: Notification requesting the next boolean open state after a supported user interaction or component-owned timer.
whenToUse: A disclosure, floating or transient component reports visibility requests from triggers, focus/hover delays, Escape, outside interaction, selection or auto-dismissal.
avoid: Incoming prop updates, initial mounting, value or selection changes (use onValueChange), and pressed or checked changes.

name: status
meaning: Consumer-selected lifecycle or availability presentation of a content item, expressed through data-state and accompanied by readable status content.
whenToUse: A content item or card represents a default, newly added, failed, completed, empty, dragged or inactive entity without owning its domain transitions.
avoid: Gauge magnitude interpretation (use state), material or semantic color families (use tone), selection, pressed state, disabled controls, or automatic domain state machines.

name: kind
meaning: The kind of a data-driven menu or navigation entry: action, destination link, separator, group label or submenu.
whenToUse: A menu or navigation component exposes a discriminated public entry schema and selects the corresponding part (a Radix menu part, a link or a separator) from each entry's kind; recipe consumers reuse the same schema.
avoid: Selection cardinality (use type), native button or input type attributes, Radix-provided props, visual treatments or changing an action into a selectable form option.

name: header
meaning: Non-interactive content shown at the top of a floating panel, above and separated from its entries.
whenToUse: A menu or panel shows identity or context, such as the signed-in user, before its entries.
avoid: Interactive controls, page or section headings, or text that is the panel's only accessible name.

name: onNavigate
meaning: Notification that the user activated a link entry rendered by the component, with the entry and the originating event; preventing the event's default lets a client-side router handle the navigation.
whenToUse: A component renders anchors from data, such as menus or navigation lists, and single-page apps must intercept navigation.
avoid: Action entries without a destination (use the entry's onSelect), form submission, or notifications of route changes that did not come from the user.

name: help
meaning: Persistent plain-text guidance or context describing a non-interactive numeric display, linked to its semantic indicator when one is present.
whenToUse: A row combines a named progress or magnitude display with a visible supporting explanation of what it represents or how to interpret it.
avoid: Form-control hints (use hint), accessible names, numeric value equivalents (use valueText), short change deltas, errors, tooltips or interactive help content.

name: title
meaning: Visible primary heading text identifying a page, section or content unit.
whenToUse: A composite component owns a distinct heading slot and renders the supplied text with native heading semantics.
avoid: Native title tooltips, accessible names of controls (use label), status-message lead sentences (use summary), or arbitrary rich content.

name: level
meaning: Native semantic rank of a rendered heading, independent of its visual typography.
whenToUse: A heading or heading-owning composition lets the consumer select the appropriate h1 through h6 rank for the document outline.
avoid: Typography size, visual register, indentation, surface elevation or changing semantics solely for appearance.

name: actions
meaning: Consumer-supplied action elements (buttons or links) rendered in a component's trailing action area.
whenToUse: A message, header or control bar offers one or two related actions that the consumer builds with system Button or Link components.
avoid: Primary navigation, generating buttons from data inside the component, or arbitrary layout content unrelated to actions.

name: footer
meaning: Consumer-supplied supplementary metadata and optional utility control rendered after a panel's main content and primary actions.
whenToUse: A card or panel offers a distinct lower area for context such as last-updated text and a refresh action, optionally on a lower tonal band.
avoid: Primary action collections (use actions), page or site footers, navigation, arbitrary replacement of the body, or a consumer-defined Material recipe.

name: summary
meaning: Short required lead sentence of a status message, shown first and emphasized, that states the situation in words.
whenToUse: A notice or toast needs a keyword sentence that carries its meaning without relying on color, followed by optional detail.
avoid: Accessible names of controls, headings of page sections, long descriptions, or native title tooltips.

name: eyebrow
meaning: Short contextual text rendered before a component's primary heading.
whenToUse: A header composition offers an optional context line above its title.
avoid: The primary heading, an accessible name, status text, metadata collections or descriptions below the heading.

name: imageCaption
meaning: Optional plain-text caption associated with one image figure, providing context or accurately supplied credit separately from the image's alternative text.
whenToUse: An image composition owns a native figcaption accompanying its media; the caption is not a replacement for descriptive alt text.
avoid: Collection captions (use caption), accessible names of controls, generated attribution, unsupported license assertions, interactive content or automatic duplication of alt text.

name: focalPoint
meaning: A supported alignment preset that selects which area of a cover-cropped image is prioritized within its reserved viewport.
whenToUse: A media component exposes a finite set of static object-position choices independently of its aspect ratio and rendered dimensions.
avoid: Absolute positioning, arbitrary inline CSS coordinates, image size/ratio, layout alignment, material tone or pointer-tracking effects.

name: modal
meaning: Whether an open floating dialog restricts focus, assistive-technology access and pointer interaction to its own content instead of allowing interaction with the surrounding page.
whenToUse: A floating dialog supports both non-modal and modal interaction through its underlying Radix primitive; the component defines dismissal and focus restoration separately.
avoid: A visual scrim, a guarantee that a workflow cannot be dismissed, overlay elevation, or custom implementations of focus trapping and outside-interaction blocking.

name: container
meaning: The DOM node that a component's portalled content is rendered into instead of the document body.
whenToUse: A component renders layered or floating content through a portal and the consumer may need another mount node, such as a shadow root, an iframe body or a subtree that scopes theme tokens.
avoid: Layout wrappers, collision or positioning boundaries for floating content, or choosing which element a component renders as (use asChild).

name: accent
meaning: One optional trailing text run visually emphasized within a display phrase while remaining part of its readable content.
whenToUse: Display typography offers a highlighted ending or punctuation after its main children.
avoid: Accessible names, status messages, arbitrary rich slots, interactive children or hiding meaningful text from assistive technology.

name: text
meaning: Main plain-text passage reproduced as a quotation, excluding separate attribution and optional trailing accent text.
whenToUse: A quotation composition renders the consumer's passage inside native blockquote semantics without accepting rich content.
avoid: Generic children, heading titles, accessible names, HTML strings intended for injection, source captions or automatically generated quotations.

name: source
meaning: Visible attribution or contextual source caption accompanying a quotation, outside the quoted passage.
whenToUse: A quote composition exposes a plain-text figcaption for consumer-supplied attribution or contextual commentary.
avoid: The quotation itself, native cite URL metadata, assuming a person's name is a work title, verified provenance claims or automatic source links.

name: shortcut
meaning: Display-only text showing a keyboard combination associated with an action; it does not register or parse a binding.
whenToUse: A launcher or menu entry shows a passive Kbd hint for a shortcut registered by its host application.
avoid: Global key listeners, platform detection, accessible-name replacement or treating display glyphs as aria-keyshortcuts syntax.

name: compact
meaning: Shows the compact icon-only presentation of a labelled launcher while retaining its accessible name and activation behavior.
whenToUse: A launcher in a narrow toolbar hides its visible text and supplementary keyboard hint without changing its responsibility.
avoid: Changing control semantics, arbitrary size presets, automatic responsive detection or removing the accessible name.

name: accentBreak
meaning: Whether the component's trailing text accent begins on a separate visual line.
whenToUse: Display typography exposes a trailing text accent that may be block or inline without changing its semantic meaning.
avoid: Automatic text splitting, truncation, extra accessible content or controlling arbitrary child layout.

name: lede
meaning: Optional introductory paragraph accompanying a section heading.
whenToUse: An editorial header composition offers short introductory copy beneath or beside its primary heading.
avoid: Accessible names, form hints, status-message summaries, heading text, arbitrary rich blocks or whole-section body content.

name: titleId
meaning: Consumer-supplied DOM ID of a composite component's heading, distinct from the composite root's native id.
whenToUse: A heading-owning composition lets an enclosing section or other external element reference its internal heading with aria-labelledby.
avoid: Styling selectors, root element IDs, shared literal IDs across instances, accessible-name text or arbitrary internal-part IDs.

name: meta
meaning: Short visible supplementary detail about an option, rendered below its label and available as its accessible description.
whenToUse: A visual choice needs a secondary fact such as layer count, dimensions or duration to distinguish options.
avoid: The option's accessible name, form instructions, numeric figure context, badges or long content.

name: thumb
meaning: Decorative preview image data for a selectable option whose identity is already supplied by its visible label.
whenToUse: A visual choice includes a cropped preview to help sighted users recognize the option.
avoid: User avatars, meaningful standalone images, editable media, video controls or the only source of option identity.

name: live
meaning: Marks the represented option as currently on air, independently of whether it is selected, with a required readable live-state annotation.
whenToUse: A scene or media choice distinguishes the currently broadcast output from a preview selection.
avoid: Selection state, loading, a generic status tone, live-region announcements or automatic broadcast activation.

name: badge
meaning: Short non-interactive text annotation over a thumbnail, rendered as a Badge and included in the option's accessible description.
whenToUse: A visual option needs an overlaid state annotation such as Live, independently of its name and selection.
avoid: Numeric counters, interactive actions, corner icon glyphs or replacing the option label.

name: gap
meaning: Token-backed spacing between adjacent children of a layout container, including row and column gaps when it wraps.
whenToUse: A reusable layout container exposes a finite set of spacing-token keys or presets for space between its children.
avoid: Inner padding (use padding), outer margins, arbitrary CSS lengths or changing the children's order.

name: caption
meaning: Optional visible contextual text accompanying a grouped collection, distinct from its accessible-name input.
whenToUse: A collection composition offers a short visible caption that may be omitted without leaving the collection unnamed.
avoid: Accessible naming (use label), heading eyebrows, image-specific attribution, long descriptions or item labels.

name: inline
meaning: Whether a collection's visible caption and its content share a wrapping row instead of being stacked vertically.
whenToUse: A captioned collection supports the same content arranged beside or below its caption without changing interaction semantics.
avoid: Keyboard navigation axes, CSS display:inline, inline prose links, field label layout or arbitrary orientation/reordering.

name: alignItems
meaning: Alignment of a layout container's children along its cross axis.
whenToUse: A flex or grid layout container exposes supported item alignment choices such as start, center, end, stretch or baseline.
avoid: Floating-panel alignment (use align), main-axis distribution (use justifyContent), text alignment or individual-child positioning.

name: justifyContent
meaning: Distribution of a layout container's children along its main axis when free space is available.
whenToUse: A reusable layout container exposes supported distribution choices such as start, center, end or between.
avoid: Cross-axis item alignment (use alignItems), floating-panel placement, text alignment or changing DOM order.

name: padding
meaning: Preset inner spacing between a container's edge and its content, mapped to spacing tokens.
whenToUse: A container primitive such as Surface offers a few token-backed padding presets, including none for edge-to-edge content.
avoid: Gaps between children (use gap), outer margins, arbitrary lengths or per-side overrides.

name: radius
meaning: Preset corner radius of a container, mapped to radius tokens.
whenToUse: A container primitive offers token-backed corner presets, such as none for bands inside a panel or full for pills.
avoid: Arbitrary lengths, per-corner overrides or shape changes that alter the component's meaning.

name: duration
meaning: Time in milliseconds a transient component stays visible before dismissing itself; Infinity disables auto-dismissal.
whenToUse: A notification or similar transient element closes automatically after a consumer-adjustable time.
avoid: Animation or transition durations, countdown targets, polling intervals or media lengths.

name: dismissLabel
meaning: Localizable accessible name of a component's built-in close or dismiss control.
whenToUse: A component renders its own icon-only dismiss control and consumers must be able to translate its name.
avoid: The accessible name of the component itself, visible button text supplied by consumers, or destructive actions.

name: actionAltText
meaning: Text describing how to perform a transient component's action through another, persistent route.
whenToUse: A transient notification offers an action that may disappear before assistive-technology users reach it (Radix Toast Action altText).
avoid: The visible action label, image alt text or accessible names of persistent controls.

name: announcementLabel
meaning: Localizable prefix that assistive technology announces before the content of each transient notification.
whenToUse: A notification system announces messages through a live region and lets consumers translate the category word.
avoid: Region or landmark names (use label), message text, or visible headings.

name: description
meaning: Optional visible plain-text sentence that explains the purpose or consequence of a dialog, rendered with its title and linked to the dialog as its accessible description.
whenToUse: A modal or alert dialog needs one short explanatory sentence next to its heading that assistive technology announces when the dialog opens.
avoid: The dialog's accessible name or heading (use title), form-field help (use hint), editorial introductions (use lede), status notes (use statusText), rich interactive content or long body copy.

name: statusText
meaning: Short visible plain-text note shown beside a panel's heading that reports the current state of its content, such as a saved draft.
whenToUse: A dialog or panel header shows a passive, consumer-updated state note next to its title.
avoid: Lifecycle presentation enums (use status), measurement condition text (use stateText), change announcements (use Toast or a live region), validation messages (use error) or the heading itself.

name: onQueryChange
meaning: Notification carrying the next search text after each user edit of a component's built-in search field.
whenToUse: A searchable collection owns its query field and consumers need the text to filter, fetch or log results themselves.
avoid: Form inputs with native onChange, selection or highlighted-item changes (use onValueChange), programmatic resets, or debounced/committed search submissions.

name: filtering
meaning: Whether a searchable collection filters its consumer-supplied entries with its built-in matcher or renders them unchanged because the consumer already filtered them.
whenToUse: A component offers built-in client-side matching but must also support server-side or custom search results.
avoid: Choosing the matching algorithm or ranking, sorting, pagination, or hiding disabled entries.

name: busy
meaning: The consumer is refreshing a collection's results; the component shows its loading message, marks the collection aria-busy and announces the pending state.
whenToUse: A searchable or remote-backed collection waits for consumer-supplied results after a query change.
avoid: Pending activation of a single control (use loading), skeleton placeholders for whole regions, progress values, or disabling the search field.

name: columns
meaning: Ordered column definitions of a data table, each with a stable id, header text and an accessor that renders the cell for a consumer-defined row; the column shape is component-specific.
whenToUse: A tabular component renders consumer-shaped rows through per-column accessors and may derive sorting, alignment or row headers from the definitions.
avoid: Collections whose entries the component renders in its own standard shape (use items), selectable form options (use options) or CSS grid layout tracks.

name: rows
meaning: Consumer-defined row records of a data table, each identified by a stable unique id; the component reads only the id and the column accessors, never the product schema.
whenToUse: A tabular component receives generic row data whose fields it renders only through column definitions.
avoid: Entries with a component-defined shape (use items), textarea line counts or layout row tracks.

name: sort
meaning: Controlled sort state of a collection: the sorted column id and direction, or null for the supplied order.
whenToUse: A component sorts its own rows locally and lets the host control which column and direction apply.
avoid: Sorting functions or comparators, server query parameters, or the order of an unsorted collection.

name: defaultSort
meaning: Initial sort state of a collection that manages its sort internally, or null for the supplied order.
whenToUse: A sortable component supports uncontrolled use alongside the sort prop.
avoid: Controlled sorting, selection values (use defaultValue) or resetting the sort after mount.

name: onSortChange
meaning: Notification that the user requested a different sort column or direction, receiving the next sort state.
whenToUse: A sortable component emits the next sort after the user activates a sortable header.
avoid: Notifications for incoming prop updates, data reloads or selection changes (use onValueChange).

name: selectable
meaning: Enables the component-owned multiple row selection controls of a data collection, including a select-all control.
whenToUse: A table or similar collection can show per-row selection checkboxes whose state is exposed through value.
avoid: Single active or current rows (use activeRowId), text selection, selectable form options or the selection value itself.

name: activeRowId
meaning: Id of the consumer-designated current row of a data collection, exposed as aria-current and given a distinct non-color cue; independent of selection.
whenToUse: The host marks the row whose details or editing context is currently shown.
avoid: Multiple selection (use value with selectable), temporary emphasis (use highlighted), focus position or row indices.

name: maxHeight
meaning: Preset maximum block size of a component's own scroll viewport; content beyond it scrolls inside the component, and absence means no cap.
whenToUse: A collection component with another dimensional axis (such as density in size) offers bounded vertical scrolling.
avoid: Arbitrary CSS lengths, density or control dimensions (use size), or page-level layout heights.

name: product
meaning: Identity of the EGDEV product or application that a structural region presents: its compact brand monogram, its visible and accessible name, and an optional home destination.
whenToUse: An application region such as a sidebar shows which product the user is in by rendering ProductMark with the product's name, optionally linking to the product's home.
avoid: The egdev corporate logo (use Logo), people or channel identities (use Avatar), page or section headings (use title), or accessible names of controls (use label).

name: endItems
meaning: Ordered secondary entries that a navigation region pins to its end, visually separated from its main collection, with the same entry shape as that region's items.
whenToUse: A rail or bar keeps utility destinations such as Settings or Help at the bottom or trailing edge, apart from its main destinations.
avoid: Non-navigation footer content or metadata (use footer), action buttons (use actions), page footers or reordering the main items.

name: onAdd
meaning: Notification that the user activated a component's built-in add control; the consumer performs the creation flow. The payload is component-specific: the originating event or the target position, such as a date. Supplying the handler renders the control.
whenToUse: A collection, planning or navigation region offers an optional add entry point, globally or per slot, whose creation flow (dialog, page, installer) belongs to the application.
avoid: Adding files (use onFiles), value or selection changes (use onValueChange), navigation to an existing destination (use onNavigate) or controls that perform the creation themselves.

name: onMove
meaning: Notification that the user asked to relocate an existing item to another position, such as another calendar date, receiving the item and the target position; the consumer applies or rejects the move and re-renders.
whenToUse: A collection or planning region offers drag-and-drop or an equivalent move menu between containers and must not mutate consumer data itself.
avoid: Within-list reordering without a target container, value selection (use onValueChange), navigation (use onNavigate) or notifications of moves that did not come from the user.

name: safeArea
meaning: Whether a fixed-ratio preview canvas shows a decorative inset rectangle marking the area safe from edge cropping on output devices.
whenToUse: A preview of broadcast, video or social output shows where essential content must stay.
avoid: Device safe-area insets (env(safe-area-inset-*)) for page layout, padding presets (use padding), or interactive crop handles.

name: zones
meaning: Ordered, labelled, non-interactive guide rectangles drawn over a preview canvas in percentages of its size, each showing which area a device or context displays.
whenToUse: A preview must show which part of the output is visible on specific devices or layouts, with a visible name per guide.
avoid: Interactive regions or hotspots, image maps, navigation entries (use items), crop or selection tools, or unlabelled color-only overlays.

name: figureCaption
meaning: Optional visible plain-text caption of a non-image figure, such as a preview canvas or diagram, rendered as its native figcaption.
whenToUse: A composite component renders a figure whose caption identifies what is previewed, such as its output name and resolution.
avoid: Single image figures (use imageCaption), collection captions (use caption), headings (use title), accessible-name-only inputs (use label), or interactive content.

name: sideNavigation
meaning: Consumer-supplied primary navigation region that a layout template docks beside its main content, such as a sidebar or compact rail organism.
whenToUse: An application layout places an already composed side navigation organism and owns its docking, sticky positioning and responsive visibility, while the organism owns its navigation data and behavior.
avoid: Navigation data or entry arrays (use items), utility entries inside a navigation region (use endItems), panel metadata (use footer), secondary non-navigation panels or a bottom bar (use bottomNavigation).

name: bottomNavigation
meaning: Consumer-supplied primary navigation region that a layout template docks at the bottom edge of the view below its main content, such as a mobile tab bar organism.
whenToUse: An application layout shows a bottom bar of top-level destinations on narrow viewports, owning its docking and responsive visibility while the organism owns its destinations.
avoid: Navigation data or entry arrays (use items), page footers or metadata (use footer), floating action buttons, sheets or drawers, or side regions (use sideNavigation).

name: scene
meaning: A named pose family of a decorative effect, optionally evaluated at consumer-supplied local progress.
whenToUse: Select a decorative effect's supported camera, assembly or explosion scene; scene names are component-specific.
avoid: Engine parameter presets (use effect-profile), Material treatments, page choreography, task progress or lifecycle state.

name: progress
meaning: Consumer-supplied normalized local progress used to evaluate a decorative effect scene.
whenToUse: Drive a decorative pose or assembly curve independently of how the consumer derives its progress; normalization is component-specific.
avoid: Task-completion or measurement semantics, accessible progress indicators, internal elapsed time or an uncontrolled user selection.

name: pointerTilt
meaning: Whether a decorative effect may apply a bounded pointer-relative tilt when its motion and input policy permits it.
whenToUse: Let a consumer disable decorative pointer tilt; eligible pointer types, scenes, bounds and reduced-motion behavior are component-specific.
avoid: Drag or selection interactions, keyboard behavior, arbitrary transforms, general animation toggles or bypassing reduced motion.
